methods.identity: Archived 2026-10-09 own Wikidata P7606/P2788 and P31, RÚIAN own code, type/local type/parent, name, original point within own municipality and same okres and kraj reverified against pinned row. Parts definition point <3 km. Conflicts held. No counts inherited from parent or namesake.
methods.population: Latest complete OBY02A: IndicatorType=2406P (1 January), POHL2=0, own six-digit obec code, maximum CasR. Parts: census uzemi_cis=42, ukaz_kod=3162, own P2788 code normalized numerically, 2021-03-26. Never use 60,47,53, MOMC, okres, kraj or parent counts.
methods.continuity: No CZ row is in unresolved baseline or subsequent identity events; no decision_only events needed.
methods.full_ledger: ledger_full_cz_pop_v5x.jsonl retained in audit work folder; raw sources and per-record full evidence retained there.
methods.scope: Only population and population_year; 2026 observations preserved when exact official values agree. A newer unavailable reference year is held.
